cases.name: Kristin Noel David
cases.about: She was a college senior at the University of Idaho pursuing a double major in broadcast journalism and political science.
cases.narrative: On 7/4/1981, her headless torso and leg were found along the Snake River in Clarkston Washington. Then her dismembered head, arms and part of a leg were found downriver. Her remains had been concealed inside black plastic bags and some of the body parts were wrapped in pages from various April 1981 editions of the local newspaper.
